question: A charity toy drive began with 4 identical bins, each already holding 133 toys, combined into one total. A local business added 22 more toys. A school donated 72 more toys. A weekend rush added 51 more toys. A shipping error caused 608 toys to be sent to the wrong location. A last-minute matching pledge tripled what remained. How many toys were left after the matching pledge?

A bakery started with 158 pastries. They added 6 items from a special order. They doubled them for the display. Then added 16 more pastries. Finally, 37 more items arrived. Using the word 'triple', how many pastries does the bakery have after morning production?

A community orchard started with 87 young trees and lost 51 of them in a storm. Each surviving tree produced 6 baskets of fruit that autumn. Every basket held 5 kilograms of apples. The orchard shed can store 90 baskets at once. The volunteers sold 599 kilograms at the village market. The next season a bumper harvest of the same fruit doubled the orchard's remaining stock of apples. How many kilograms of apples did the orchard then hold?

A business started with 222 items. They removed 99 items. They added 26 items. They added 29 items. They removed 54 items. Finally, they tripled. A competing business had 200 items. How many items do they have?

A document had 177 pages in the morning. By midday, 174 pages were edited and removed. The remaining pages were divided equally into thirds. By afternoon, they doubled the count. By evening, 1 page was lost. Finally, 59 pages were recovered. How many pages did the document contain by end of day?

A scout troop collected 53 tins of pencils for a school appeal. They handed 30 of those tins to a shelter across town. Over the following week the number of tins the troop was holding doubled. Every tin in their store contains 9 pencils. A teacher then dropped off 15 loose pencils to go with them. The troop's log records meeting times in minutes instead of hours. How many pencils does the troop have altogether?
A warehouse had 118 boxes. They added 77 more. They multiplied by 6. They divided by 5. They multiplied by 4. How many boxes?

In the morning a joiner had 95 planks in the workshop and collected 65 more from the timber yard. Each plank was cut into 3 equal pieces. At midday the pieces were shared equally between 5 sheds, and the pieces in the first shed were then divided equally between 4 workbenches. Every piece on the first bench needs 8 nails to fix it in place. In the evening the joiner found 53 loose nails in a jar and added them to that bench's supply. The timber yard charges 12 pounds for delivery. How many nails are on the first bench?

In the morning the tour company checked its coaches: each coach has 82 seats, but 8 seats on every coach were taken out for luggage racks, and 7 coaches were assigned to the festival. A minibus fleet with 77 seats in total was added to the same booking. The festival site is 120 kilometres from the city. In the afternoon 530 of the seats were sold to fans. In the evening the company sold every remaining seat at a last-minute price of 4 dollars each. How many dollars did the company take from the last-minute sales?
A student started with 23 pages. They added 44. They multiplied by 7. They multiplied by 4. They added 15. They noted a distractor task. How many pages total?

A factory had 119 units. They removed 108 units. They multiplied by 6 times. They multiplied by 3 times. They added 61 units. Someone had a dozen units. David had fewer units. Maria had more. The total progressed. How many units?

In the morning Omar stocked the top shelf of a rack with 98 boxes and the bottom shelf with exactly the same number, so the rack held twice that many boxes across its 2 shelves. He stocked 7 racks the same way, and then placed 21 loose boxes on a pallet beside them. In the afternoon a lorry took 999 boxes from the warehouse, and a courier returned 24 boxes that had been refused. In the evening 51 boxes were found to be damaged and were thrown away. How many boxes does Omar's warehouse hold now?
A project lead had 120 tasks. She added 28. She added 54. She added 73. This was tripled. She removed 131. A staff member had 56 tasks. What was her final count?

A vineyard harvested 165 crates of grapes in the first pick. Six neighboring vineyards each matched that harvest exactly, making the total seven times as large. A shipment to a spoiled batch removed 897 crates. A second round of six matching vineyards joined in, making the total seven times as large again. A co-op merger with two more equal partners made it three times as large. Finally, a regional festival order made the total five times as large. How many crates of grapes did the vineyard end up with?

Early on Sunday a bike hire kiosk had 143 helmets on its racks. Groups hired 135 helmets before lunch. In the early afternoon 17 helmets came back, and later a delivery brought 39 new ones. A dozen of the helmets are the small children's size. The kiosk stands 6 kilometres from the town centre. That evening the manager fitted every helmet in the kiosk with 9 replacement pads. How many replacement pads did the manager fit?

Riverside School's Year 6 has 131 students, but 12 were absent on the day of the trip collection. Each student who was present handed in 5 dollars. The parents' association then tripled the amount collected, so the fund stood at triple what the students had paid. The coach hire and museum tickets cost 1762 dollars, which came out of the fund. Afterwards one parent donated 35 dollars, and another parent also gave 35 dollars. How many dollars are left in the trip fund?
A store had 222 items. They multiplied by 4. They removed 349. They removed 171. They removed 105. They multiplied by 8. They added 56. How many items?

Bo's route around the park is 152 steps long, and every morning he walks it 3 times. He did that on each of the 7 mornings last week, and on the last morning he also walked 30 extra steps to the shop for milk. His neighbour Cy, who is recovering from a knee operation, walked exactly half as many steps as Bo did over the whole week, so Bo was well ahead of Cy. How many steps did Cy walk last week?
A farm had 79 crops. In spring, they quadrupled. In summer, they added 60. In fall, they added 34. In winter, they quadrupled again for storage preparation. How many crops are stored?

A project had 168 tasks initially. They multiplied by 6 through expansion. They removed 618 after simplification. They divided by 3 to create phases. They multiplied by 4. They added 31 more complex tasks. Finally, 156 were removed for prioritization. A larger project had 1000 tasks but separate scope. How many priority tasks remain?

Marcus had 85 dollars in his wallet at sunrise. In the morning, he earned 25 more dollars helping a neighbor move furniture. In the afternoon, he spent 61 dollars on new running shoes and another 38 dollars on a bicycle tune-up. That evening, his cousin gave him an amount equal to what remained, making his money 2 times as much as before. A shop window that evening advertised sneakers for 99 dollars, though he didn't buy any. How much money did Marcus have by the end of the evening?

On Tuesday morning a comic shop unpacked 102 boxes, and each box held 5 bundles of comics. During the afternoon every bundle was broken open into 7 single comics. In the evening the comics were shared equally between the chain's 3 shops, and the high street shop's share is the one to follow. A collector then sold 52 comics to the high street shop. How many comics does the high street shop have?

A project starts with 172 units. In the morning, 25 are removed (147). By afternoon, it multiplies by 9 (1323). By evening, it multiplies by 3 (3969). It adds 27 (3996). It loses 3840 (156). How many units?

Two rival bakeries compared their cupcake orders. Sweet Spot Bakery had 74 cupcakes ordered, tracked over 60 minutes, or 1 hour, of the morning rush. Four more matching orders made the total five times as large. A wedding order added 73 more cupcakes. A birthday order added 22 more. A school order added 70 more. Finally, a catering order added 47 more, well ahead of the rival bakery's order of 300. How many cupcakes did Sweet Spot Bakery end up with in their order?

On Saturday morning Tia had 27 tubs of paint in the shed and used 26 of them on the mural. The tub still unopened fills 9 small jars. In the afternoon she shared those jars equally between 3 art tables. In the evening her friend Ola set out 3 tables so that each one matched Tia's first table exactly, jar for jar, though Ola had started the day with far fewer jars than Tia. How many jars did Ola set out on those 3 tables altogether?
